summary: The note describes The Grand Bistros, an annual culinary competition held in downtown Chicago from September 15th to September 20th, where 50 chefs from across the country represent regional cuisines and compete for the title of Bistro Champion. It covers the daily themes and mystery ingredients, the judging panel, notable dishes, cultural side events, the Future Palates Pavilion for young cooks, the Green Kitchen Award for sustainability, and the Gourmet Gala finale.
one_line: The Grand Bistros is a Chicago culinary competition where 50 chefs showcase regional American cuisines, with judging, cultural events, youth programs and a sustainability award.
key_facts: The Grand Bistros runs from September 15th to September 20th in downtown Chicago.
The Grand Bistros was established in 2025 to celebrate the diverse culinary scene across different regions.
This year 50 chefs from every corner of the country compete for the title of Bistro Champion.
Each competition day has a theme and a mystery regional ingredient that chefs must incorporate into their dishes.
Dishes are judged on taste, presentation, technique and originality, under strict time constraints.
Chef Michaela Henderson from New Orleans is known for Cajun and Creole cooking.
Chef Eduardo Garcia from New Mexico cooks with ancho chiles and roasted corn in a cast-iron skillet.
The judging panel includes food critics, celebrity chefs and gastronomes such as Chef Pierre Dubois and Italian-American food writer Gina Bellini.
Notable dishes include Chef Amina Zhao's Pacific Northwest-inspired cedar plank salmon with a hazelnut crust and Chef Jake Rodriguez's smoked brisket taco with a prickly pear barbecue sauce.
Food historian Dr. Emma Clarkson gives talks on the origins of regional dishes, and local artisans exhibit crafts such as hand-forged kitchen knives and pottery.
The Future Palates Pavilion is dedicated to children and young adults, offering mini-competitions and cooking classes mentored by past winners and local chefs.
The Green Kitchen Award goes to the chef who delights the palate with the smallest environmental footprint, using local produce and cutting food waste.
The competition culminates in the Gourmet Gala, where only the finest dishes are showcased and one chef is named victor.
